name: Daffodil
source:
A top executive at ADONIS.
He appears as an incorporeal AR avatar that looks like a cat.
Normally, he's not in a position to talk to Kugi, who is just an investigator, but he notices Kugi's talent when he was a boy and recruits him to ADONIS, so he keeps an eye on him.
